content:
Maria: FYI customer ByteWave hitting repeated 502/504s during today's morning ramp, started ~2026-03-17T11:02Z. They report web requests timing out while inference requests queue up. Request IDs: rw-req-9a2f, rw-req-9a33.
Jordan: Can you paste a sample of the gateway logs and the scaledobject for that tenant? Suspect HPA/KEDA interplay. :eyes: 
Maria: Pasting trimmed gateway logs and the ScaledObject annotations we saw in the tenant namespace.
Maria: ```
2026-03-17T11:02:12Z inference-gateway ERROR request rw-req-9a2f downstream timeout after 30s (queue depth=12)
2026-03-17T11:02:13Z pool-manager WARN tenant=bytewave scaleup delayed, lastProbe=40s, desiredReplicas=3 current=0
2026-03-17T11:02:15Z autoscaler INFO keda poll interval 30s, activationThreshold=100
```
Maria: ScaledObject snippet: ```annotations:
  keda.sh/activationThreshold: "100"
  keda.sh/pollingInterval: "30"
  redwood.io/prewarm: "false"
```
Alex: Hmm the prewarm flag is false for that tenant? That would prevent warm cache/populating KV caches on replica startup and prolong cold-run init. Also pollingInterval=30s is high for bursty tenants.
Jordan: I suspect two things: 1) activationThreshold set too high so KEDA delays scale trigger until queue is big; 2) prewarm disabled so each new pod takes longer to become ready -> readinessProbe misses. That matches the pool-manager log.
Maria: Support ticket says customer saw a repeated pattern: traffic spike -> gateway queues -> 502s ~30s -> spikes die down. They think token/billing checks were fine (no auth errors).
Alex: Quick mitigation suggestions: increase minReplicas for that tenant to 2, set redwood.io/prewarm: "true" in their customer config, and lower keda.sh/pollingInterval to 5-10s.
Jordan: I'll take the oncall actions. Steps I'm running now: `kubectl -n tenants get scaledobject bytewave -o yaml` then patch annotations. If patch helps we can roll these changes via the tenant config flow.
Support-Bot: Ticket #RW-4587 created and linked: https://redwood.support/4587. Assigned to Jordan.
Jordan: Patch applied (rolling): `kubectl -n tenants patch scaledobject bytewave -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"keda.sh/pollingInterval":"8","redwood.io/prewarm":"true"}}}' --type=merge`
Jordan: Also bumped minReplicas=2 for tenant bytewave in provisioner DB (will persist via infra change later).
Maria: After patch we saw scale event within 12s and pool-manager log shows desiredReplicas->2 and pods come online, latency improved. Customer confirmed fewer 5xx in last 10m. :thumbsup:
Alex: We should add a guard in provisioning to reject prewarm=false for tenants flagged as bursty and add a monitoring alert for KEDA activationThreshold > 50 for production tenants.
Jordan: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up item to add a rule in the tenant policy repo and add an alert on scaledobject annotations.
Maria: Recording repro steps in the ticket: 1) reproduce with synthetic spike hitting tenant 10 RPS for 90s 2) observe keda poll and queue depth 3) inspect logs `pool-manager` and `inference-gateway` 4) patch scaledobject annotations to prewarm=true and lower pollingInterval 5) validate scaledown timing.
Alex: Also leaving a short snippet to reproduce locally: ```sh
# simulate spike
seq 1 50 | xargs -n1 -P50 curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.host/tenant/bytewave/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
```
Support-Bot: Status update added to ticket RW-4587: "mitigated by annotation patch and minReplicas bump; monitoring enabled"
Jordan: Follow-ups: deploy tenant-policy change + alerting rule, and schedule a postmortem with product & support if customer escalates.
Maria: Thanks team — closing slack triage for now, keeping ticket open for follow-ups.
